passwordReset.subject: Reset Your GoMate Password
passwordReset.title: Reset Password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your GoMate account. Click the button below to reset your password:
passwordReset.expiryNote: This link will expire in 1 hour.
passwordReset.ignoreNote: If you didn't request a password reset, please ignore this email.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your GoMate email
emailVerification.title: Verify your email
emailVerification.body: Confirm that this email belongs to you before signing in to GoMate.
emailVerification.ignoreNote: If you did not create a GoMate account, you can ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to GoMate!
welcome.title: Welcome to GoMate!
welcome.body: Thank you for joining GoMate, a teaming platform focused on the Shenzhen hiking scene.
welcome.feature1: Browse popular hiking routes around Shenzhen
welcome.feature2: Create or join a hiking team
welcome.feature3: Set off with like-minded hiking enthusiasts
